title: All Missing Persons locations in GTA 6
summary: Catch Port Gellhorn's creepy serial killer and end the 20-year mystery.
body: The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2. Your stint as a fledgling detective begins in an abandoned warehouse near Mo's shop in Gellhorn, though there are two ways to flag the objective on your map and start the hunt for Gellhorn's serial killer. If you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin. This is how I began the quest the first time, after following a pack of coyotes through a small opening on the side of the abandoned warehouse. This route gives you an extra text conversation where Jason sends Lucia creepy photos from the warehouse. Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters. Afterward, head to the abandoned warehouse as a couple or go alone, and squeeze through the crawl space. Enter the abandoned warehouse trophy room After crawling inside the warehouse, walk to the far end and turn right to enter the glowing red room. Go a little farther to find the, uh, "trophies," and inspect all three lockers, along with the missing persons poste…

title: GTA 6 has weird purple streetlights because actual Florida screwed up its streetlights
summary: Rockstar recreated an embarrassing mishap in Florida infrastructure.
body: When you're exploring a world as realistic and well-observed as GTA 6's Leonida, it's rare for a piece of benign infrastructure to stick out. But on night one of my playthrough, I clocked some weird streetlights. Why are some of them turquoise? (Image credit: Rockstar) And hey, why are these purple? Rockstar Rockstar A stylistic choice by Rockstar? Maybe, but it's awfully specific, and I had a feeling there was a deeper intention behind it. So I DMed my buddy Henry, an honest-to-god Floridian who was also playing GTA 6, and asked what's up. At first he thought strange streetlights in the Key Lento area of the map were special lights meant to not disorient turtles, but those are typically red, so probably not. And that doesn't explain the purple ones. So Henry reached out to friends in south Florida, the region that Leonida's biggest cities are based on, and they cracked the case wide open. "The purple [lights] are definitely real. We have a ton of them down here because whoever is in charge of that in the government bought a bunch of defective lights," the anonymous Floridian responded. I have mostly noticed purple lights in Crosstown so far. (Image credit: Rockstar) Yes, actual F…

title: GTA 6 vault: How to open them during big bank jobs
summary: You can make well over $100,000 in a single crime if you open the bank vault and safe deposit boxes.
body: Opening a GTA 6 bank vault is one of the best ways to make off with a big score during a robbery, with potentially $100,000 or more in bills and valuables from a single heist. But those huge bank vault doors are completely impenetrable, and confusingly, even after you've learned how to drill into a vault as part of a Chapter 3 story mission , you still won't be able to open vault doors in open world bank robberies. Here's the trick: you've got to get someone to open bank vault doors for you. Only then can you steal all that sweet cash. HOW TO OPEN A BANK VAULT Complete jobs for Yasmani Your GTA 6 fence , Yasmani, will begin offering you tips once you start selling him stolen goods in Chapter 3: jewelry store heists targeting specific items and which ATM jobs have the most cash, for example. Pay it, and he'll give you the locations of two security vans (armored cars) in Vice City. They'll show up on your map as pink icons. title: Someone counted all 5,588 buildings in GTA 6, and it turns out you can go inside 28% of them
summary: Maybe even more will open up for Online, too.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 hasn't even been out for a week yet, and someone has already done the math on how many buildings in the whole of Leonida you can actually walk into. For those of you who are curious: it's 1,563 buildings. That is frankly ridiculous. I don't think I've ever been inside 1,563 different buildings in my entire life, although I am a creature of habit, so that could explain things. The player who shared these stats, Aileos , does note that there are 5,588 buildings in total, so the enterable buildings only account for a fraction of that, just over 25%. A player counted every building in GTA VI. Out of 5588 buildings, 1563 are enterable from r/GTA6 There are some who will look at this with a glass-half-empty perspective, and I get it. This world is so cool, it's easy to want more of it, but as another player points out , "This would've sent us into psychosis a few years back". Sometimes it's better to focus on what we have rather than what we don't have. After all, how many buildings will you realistically enter in your GTA 6 playthrough? Probably not 1,563. We've spent the past week here in the PC Gamer Slack channel marvelling at just how many random encounters you c…

title: How to steal the Pegassi Infernus in GTA 6
summary: Pilfer the '96 Infernus from the police lockup for Randy.
body: Stealing the Pegassi Infernus in GTA 6 can be quite tricky, considering it's being held in the police department lockup, the building to the west of the police station in southwest Crosstown. You can access the building via a yellow window cleaning elevator on the southern side of the building. But this won't appear until Randy texts and gives you the Infernus's location. If you go here before, your options for entering are far more limited and risky, so it's worth waiting. To get to the car: Use the elevator to get inside. Turn right, then left, and make your way up to the seventh level of the multi-story car park—the purple Pegassi Infernus is easy to recognise since it's the only sports car in there. Select the key cloning option to get inside. Now you just need to drive down a few levels to exit via the police station parking lot—which I'd recommend—or keep going all the way down to exit at the bottom of the car park. Remember, you need to drive fast to stop the tracker going off, and if you hear it beeping, you should speed up to prevent it pinging the cops. If you do bash around the car a bit, you can get it repaired at a gas station on the way. Bring it back in pristine con…

title: How to steal an ATM and get a winched vehicle in GTA 6
summary: Yank out ATMs and grab the cash with Yasmani's tips.
body: Stealing an ATM in GTA 6 requires a few different things: a winched vehicle to haul it out of the wall and drive off, plus the dye pack jammer that stops marked bills from exploding pink all over your lovely cash. There are two ways to get a winched truck. The video above shows a location at the crop duster landing strip in Frogswater where you can steal one, but you can also mod any truck at a mod shop to add a winch. If you don't have a truck to mod, there's a unique one you can steal from the Kolt & Associates June Warehouse robbery in Port Gellhorn, just south of Sarena's Bargain Store, which you could then register with Moses and mod at Wasteland Off-Road in the north of the town. You can also get a winched truck around the back of Yasmani's vape shop in Little Cuba—the fence who gives you the ATM tip offs. You'll also need the dye pack jammer, which you get in the Chapter 3 main mission, Credit Check, for Raul. Once you have both of these, you're ready to rob an ATM. If you complete all three of Yasmani's jewelry thefts (also in Chapter 3), he'll call a little later and offer tips about full ATMs, giving you three for free that you have a 24 hour window to hit. Here's ho…

body: Grand Theft Auto 6 has managed to get its claws into just about everyone. Honestly, I can't go anywhere without hearing something from the soundtrack or someone talking about how much fun it is to joyride around Leonida. And now it's even infested the sports I watch. In second place was his McLaren teammate and previous world champion for 2025, Lando Norris. title: Analyst estimates Call of Duty lost 44% of its players when GTA 6 came out, and unlike fans of its live-service competitors they've been slow to come back
summary: Turns out Fortnite players are more loyal.
body: Sony has been crowing about Grand Theft Auto 6 setting a new record for concurrent PlayStation players , which isn't bad for a game that's currently only singleplayer. It isn't just beating the records set by the giants of multiplayer gaming back when they released, though. It's also eating their lunch right now. Alinea Analytics reports that Call of Duty, Fortnite, and EA Sports FC 27 all saw their number of daily active users drop when GTA 6 released. "Call of Duty got it the worst of the three," Alinea's head of market analysis Rhys Elliott wrote, "dropping 42% from an average of 7.5M DAUs to 4.4M" according to the company's estimates. Fortnite only lost 28% of its players, the firm claims based on PlayStation and Xbox data—Alinea's Fortnite figures do not take Switch, mobile, or Epic Games Store players into account—An estimated five million of them choosing to buy groceries and fix the stairs instead of parachuting out of a bus over the weekend. EA Sports FC 27 suffered a similar loss. "FC 27's DAUs dropped by about 27% when GTA 6 launched," according to Elliott, "from 5.9M to 4.3M." But where player numbers for both of those games were trending back up four days after GTA 6'…

title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
summary: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6.
body: CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6. While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, y…

title: Nvidia patch finally eradicates the SSD-hammering bug its last hotfix didn't actually fix
summary: "The evil is defeated."
body: Nvidia's latest GeForce Game Ready driver, version 621.40 , is out now. "This new Game Ready Driver provides the best gaming experience for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, and Assetto Corsa Rally," the notes say, "and the addition of DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering to Where Winds Meet." Which is kind of burying the lead. This patch is really a hotfix for a hotfix, an update that finally addresses the bug with previous driver packages that had them pointlessly rewriting a log file over and over, quickly adding up to tens of GB every hour and potentially damaging SSDs nobody can afford to replace any more. Over the weekend Nvidia released a hotfix that supposedly caught the bug, only for users to discover it merely delayed its onset . Rather than setting in immediately after a reboot, it would wait until your PC had been on for a while before shitting the bed. If you're one of the people who leaves your computer running overnight then I hope you stayed on version 621.01, the last safe driver package before the current one. Forum users have been testing out version 621.40 and it seems to have not only stopped the Nvidia container service from freaking out and rewriting its lo…

title: Fan-favorite Diablo 2 anniversary bosses and items won't disappear when Diablo 4's next season starts
summary: Most of the secrets from the current season aren't going anywhere.
body: According to every Diablo 4 player known to man, I screwed up by skipping its last season . Blizzard shoved just about every iconic Diablo 2 boss and item it could think of into the modern game, and, by all accounts, it was one of the best seasons it ever had. Even though the Season of Hell's Legacy is about to come to an end, Blizzard has delivered good news for me and everyone else who missed it: Most of it will remain in the game permanently. On December 1, when the Season of Tyrael's Gambit begins, all of the unique Prime Evil boss fights will still be available, along with the Diablo world boss, Moophisto, and a handful of Diablo 2-inspired items, including the Hellfire Torch Charm. However, the craftable items, like the Enigma chest piece that gives you a free teleport skill, will not carry over. Even without all the craftable unique items, that's quite a lot of stuff to keep around. Blizzard tends to ditch seasonal additions as soon as a new season starts, and you usually have to wait a while to see them slipped back into the game in a slightly altered form. title: An Among Us player and his mom helped rescue a kidnapped girl who'd been missing for more than a year
summary: After connecting in the game, the teens began talking on Discord, which ultimately led to the discovery of her location.
body: A 17-year-old girl who had been missing for more than a year was rescued and returned home by the FBI after a friend she made while playing Among Us, and his mother, were able to track down her location and pass it along to law enforcement. Landon Tresp told the BBC that he and the anonymous girl "kind of just clicked" when they started chatting online while playing Among Us. She eventually told Tresp she was a runaway who'd been held against her will for more than a year. After learning more, Tresp, 16, told his mother, Khristina, about the exchange; she was initially suspicious, but after speaking with the girl directly on Discord and reading reports of her disappearance, she took action, asking for a piece of mail or document with a full name on it, which the girl provided. With that, Khristina began digging into tax and property records to find relevant addresses, which she then used to find photos on real estate sites. summary: There are tons of unique and collectible weapons in GTA 6 but these are the best and easiest to snap up early in the game.
body: GTA 6 has a ton of unique weapon variants all with their own names and mods. They're all special custom builds of stock guns and weapons with unique skins, but some of them are way more worth the trouble to hunt down than others. You'll find some of them easily—every Ammu-Nation has a unique gun sitting out for you to buy. The best unique weapons are a little more hidden. There are treasure hunts and easter eggs and a whole lot that you'll grab by fighting your way through a gang hideout. Best unique weapons to get early ⭐ Assassin Nipper .38 (Image credit: Rockstar) Assassin Nipper location in the Permit Keys. Rockstar Rockstar This is the easiest unique weapon to grab right at the start of the game and totally worth the boat ride to grab it. There isn't even any combat to get to it, like many of these other uniques. The Assassin Nipper comes with a suppressor attachment, which is a really expensive mod to buy early in the game. Pick it up as soon as you've got free range in Key Lento from an old shipwreck in the Permit Keys near the military base location . title: How to steal the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular in GTA 6
summary: Where to find the car wanted by Randy.
body: One of the cars Randy wants in GTA 6 is the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular—and don't let the name fool you, its a slick and speedy ride that'll you'll be tempted to keep for yourself. But Randy doesn't know the locations of many of the cars on his wishlist, and can't point you to the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular: you just need to keep an eye out for it. Luckily, we spotted it ourselves, so just follow the simple steps below to find it. Ocelot Bloodless Jugular location Head to Belville : It's a town in Leonard County, in the central eastern part of the map, a bit south of Lake Leonida and north of La Perle. In the northern edge of Belville there's a little cluster of four homes laid out almost in an X pattern. The southernmost home of that cluster has a garage you can break into. Once you open the garage door, you'll see the white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. You'll need the key cloner to get in, which I assume you already have since you're doing jobs for Randy. No need to worry about the tracker , it's a standard one so it won't transmit your location to the cops. You still don't want to dawdle, because the owner of the car has a gun and he's not afraid to use it. He'll start shooting if he s…

title: Studio founded by former Apex Legends leaders is closing without releasing a game
summary: Gravity Well, founded in 2020 as an "anti-crunch" game studio, lost its funding earlier this year and wasn't able to find a new backer.
body: Gravity Well, an "anti-crunch" studio founded in 2020 by former Apex Legends executive producer Drew McCoy and lead software engineer Jon Shiring, is entering "hibernation" after losing funding for its game. Gravity Well's launch in 2020 came with high hopes. Founded by veterans of Call of Duty, Titanfall, and Apex Legends, it made the health of the team "an absolute top priority," McCoy said at the time. "That means we are anti-crunch. That means good compensation. That means everyone at Gravity Well has creative freedom, because when someone else makes all of the decisions, work isn't fun and the end product isn't as good." But like so many other ambitious new studios launched around that time, it fell victim to the post-pandemic retrenchment and has effectively shuttered without releasing a game. The shutdown comes just a month after the studio laid off more than 40 people in what it said was a "fight for survival" caused by the loss of funding. It also warned that "given the current state of the industry our future is uncertain." (Image credit: Gravity Well) A message now posted on the Gravity Well website (via RPS ) says the funding situation hasn't changed, and "sadly the ti…

title: GTA 6 is great because of all its murderous NPCs, not in spite of them
summary: Nobody wants to work for their crimes anymore, smh.
body: It's come to my attention that some of us aren't having a very fun time with the NPCs in Grand Theft Auto 6 . I've seen videos and threads of players complaining about not being able to steal cars because of crack head drivers , getting hunted down by killer NPCs , and just generally having a harder time traversing Leonida because who knows what bloodthirsty beast hides behind each corner? And to this I say, your steak is too buttery? Your lobster too juicy? My first interaction with one of the unfriendly residents of Leonida started when I accidentally bumped into their car. Because I am wholly unaware of my surroundings, I didn't even notice that anyone was mad at me as I listened to my pop songs and carried on driving towards my mission. Little did I know that right behind me was a four-wheeler with a driver who had steam coming out of her ears. The driver gets out and starts screaming about payback. I have no idea what I've done, but this is GTA 6, I'm not taking this slander. …

title: All GTA 6 Kitty Litter lab locations
summary: Take Out Kitty Litter for Tyrone across the Vice City.
body: Taking Out Kitty Litter's lab locations in GTA 6 is a mission in Tyrone's questline, and sees you searching the city for 18 secret labs (after the first one he directs you to). Every lab has a red smoking chimney and a blue and white Spin On This laundry van parked outside. It'll take a little while, but it's well worth it to get the unique gold SMG at the end. Plus, Tyrone will start buying narcotics from you for the highest price possible. To destroy each lab, simply shoot a smoking pink flask and then run away. I've also laid these out in the most optimal order , separated into regions, so you're not driving back and forth across Vice City. Last note: if you want to unlock map markers for the labs yourself versus relying on these videos, you can threaten cooks in certain labs to potentially reveal them, or talk to Tyrone when you're fencing goods. title: GTA 6 might play best when it hits PC, but it'll be best played with a controller
summary: I cannot get over all the ways Rockstar has turned a controller into an immersion tool.
body: I hate to credit Sony's aggressive (and presumably very expensive) marketing campaign for GTA 6—you know, the one which appeared to have also plucked the ability for Xbox to even mention the game by name. That's something I'm still shocked was even a thing anyone was allowed to do. So I won't credit it… mostly. We all already know that PC is going to get the best version of GTA 6 when it finally hits our desktops, whenever that might be. But I am going to agree with one part of the whole "Grand Theft Auto 6 plays best on PS5" shtick: the DualSense controller. It's so good that I fear those who reach for a mouse and keyboard will be missing out on some incredible immersion. In control I never expected a controller to actively add to my experience, but I also forgot just how many goodies Sony stuffed into this thing. Seriously, Rockstar has taken full advantage of everything the peripheral has to offer. I've been weaving through traffic way more in GTA 6 thanks to a huge increase in general vehicle density and some criminally narrow roads that can cause some major bottlenecks. title: Sony: GTA 6 set record for 'highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation' ever
summary: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success.
body: GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation. "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC . But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said. That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5, or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share …

summary: All the endings (and a couple variations) for GTA 6 we've seen so far.
body: Obviously, massive spoilers follow for GTA 6 endings! There are multiple endings to GTA 6 , and while we haven't experienced them all personally here at PC Gamer, the gaming community has been sharing them around for anyone curious about what they may have missed. The ending you get depends on the choices you make during the final GTA 6 story mission , but also depends on how you handled Jason and Lucia's romance and criminal profiles throughout the game, so seeing every version of the ending would mean not just playing the ending multiple times, but having different playthroughs of the game altogether. There are a couple of endings that I don't consider "different" from each other but do have some differences leading up to them, which I'll explain below. There may also be additional endings we haven't seen yet, so we may update this guide in the future. title: Cyberpunk 2 creative director says he's suffering from 'GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression,' jokes that 'Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled'
summary: Tough act to follow.
body: It's been a big week for videogames—or rather, videogame. Grand Theft Auto 6 is enjoying what may very well be the single greatest media launch in history, securing over $3.7 billion in launch sales. But as Rockstar enjoys its acclaim, other developers—like Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski—are professing some anxiety about releasing their own games in a post-GTA 6 world. "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle," Sarzynski said on Bluesky over the weekend, joking that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled." (Image credit: Igor Sarzynski, Anna Megill on Bluesky) That news came as a surprise to Cyberpunk 2 lead writer Anna Megill, who replied with a baffled "But wait—" Sarzynski was, of course, just goofing. But I'm sympathetic to any game dev who might be feeling an amount of apprehension about being measured against GTA 6's success, particularly when there's a genre overlap. In Cyberpunk 2's case, however, CD Projekt is very much in its own lane: Cyberpunk is a different thematic setting, with entirely…

title: Former Dragon Age boss questions whether BioWare should have become 'a one project studio' dropping either Mass Effect or Dragon Age to survive EA
summary: "There are lots of studios within EA that did that and it didn't work—they still got murdered in their sleep."
body: Many are asking themselves how a legendary studio like BioWare, which is responsible for staples of the PC gaming genre like Neverwinter Nights , Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , and the OG Baldur's Gate , alongside Mass Effect and Dragon Age , can be shuttered. Former Dragon Age executive producer Mark Darrah has already explained how the studio was backed into a corner by EA. Escalating financial pressure led to the poor decisions and subpar games we saw ahead of BioWare's closure. But what if it had all gone differently? Despite everything, Darrah does question whether there was a way for BioWare to survive under EA. (Image credit: EA) "BioWare's entire existence under EA—it was essentially zero sum, if somebody was getting resources it was coming at the expense of somebody else," Darrah explains. "It's almost like BioWare has run exactly the same way for its entire existence. But the external constraints were different. So in the early days when BioWare needed more people it hired more people. That's like Baldur's Gate 1, Neverwinter Nights, in the early days when we have all these different threads and branches. "And then in 2007/2008, when the EA constraints come in,…

title: Cyberleek releases executable for GTA 6 Xbox build leaked last week: 'The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects'
summary: The notorious GTA 6 leaker called it "an early Christmas gift."
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek appears to have followed through on their threat to release the executable of the Xbox build of GTA 6 they put into the wild last week, calling it "an early Christmas gift" for followers and explicitly linking the leak to efforts to recreate the game on PC: "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects." Cyberleek released a near-complete build of GTA 6 late last week, holding back only the main exe—the part that makes everything else run, basically—until either their crypto coin achieved a $15 million market cap, or November 23, whichever came first. The crypto missed badly, but time marches on, and so here we are. (Image credit: Cyberleek) The release of the exe, naturally, includes a call for more "donations" in its readme file (via Reddit ) which Cyberleek said will go toward a secretive project "for the gamers." They also taunted Take-Two Interactive's efforts to track them down : "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving. No budget makes a lock unbreakable, and no court order deletes what the internet already has." Leaks in the game industry aren't anyt…

title: 60 hours in GTA 6 has me yearning for an online Leonida
summary: Leonida deserves to be explored with friends.
body: I honestly can't recall the last time I took such delight in existing within a virtual world as the way I have with Grand Theft Auto 6 's Leonida. Rockstar has delivered on its promise of both breadth and depth—the map is huge, but utterly stuffed with detail. Large, open highways shrink into single lanes surrounded by construction that force me to slam the brakes. Sidewalks sparse with pedestrians eventually lead to densely packed retail areas, restaurants, and clubs. Pockets of culture erupt all over: the sheer redneckery of Port Gellhorn, the Latin culture that permeates Little Cuba, and the affluent snootiness of Capri that has cops flinging microaggressions in every direction. You don't need to undertake any missions in these areas to understand the people that live here—Rockstar has nailed so much of the environmental storytelling and the conversations between NPCs you'll stumble on as you roam. (Image credit: Rockstar Games) It's a world that, when I first ventured into it, I had no interest in exploring in a multiplayer setting. title: World of Warcraft: Forever review: The first proper MMO adventure I've been on in years
summary: A second wind for old-school MMOs that has me hooked.
body: World of Warcraft: Forever has, much as the original World of Warcraft did back in 2004, completely consumed my life. I write about games for a living, mind, so the attention vortex it has wrought upon me is primarily professional obligation, rather than just irresponsibility. Need to know What is it?: A reimagining of 2004's World of Warcraft, with new balancing, lighting, dungeons, and items. Expect to pay: A monthly subscription of $14.99/£10.99. Optional race and early-game zone behind a £25.99/$30 paywall. Developer: Blizzard Entertainment Publisher: Blizzard Entertainment Reviewed on: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, AMD Ryzen 7 5800 8-Core Processor, 16GB RAM, Force MP600 SSD Multiplayer?: Yes Link: Official site But at the time of writing, it has been 443 hours since Forever's launch. I have spent 147 of those hours asleep (less, but let's just pretend I've been getting a solid eight), leaving around 296 hours of my waking mind. 230 of them have been spent playing World of Warcraft. That's a deeply concerning amount of time if I wasn't getting a salary to review it—it has been part of my 9-5.
